ask.question: The graph asserts on L4, from f10, that "the TL1A trimer engages three DR3 protomers through a canonical TNF-superfamily interface burying 1840 A^2", attributed to a 2.4 A crystal structure. WE CHECKED, AND NO SUCH STRUCTURE EXISTS. OUR MEASUREMENT (PDB polymer-entity census against UniProt Q93038, run 2026-08-15): DR3/TNFRSF25 has exactly three deposited entities - 5YEV, 5YGP and 5YGS - and all three are the INTRACELLULAR death domain (Q93038 residues 322-415), single-entity, no partner chain. There is no DR3 ectodomain structure of any kind and no TL1A/DR3 complex deposited anywhere. The only deposited TL1A/receptor complexes are 3K51 and 3MI8, both TL1A with the decoy receptor DcR3 (TNFRSF6B, O95407); we measure their buried surface at 2049 A^2 total / 1024 A^2 per side on the 3K51 biological assembly, which is not 1840 A^2 under either convention. SOURCES ASSERTING THE CLAIM: f10 via p8, single source, is_own_result true. SOURCES AGAINST IT: the PDB itself (5YEV, 5YGP, 5YGS, 3K51, 3MI8) plus our own cofold of TL1A(O95150 72-251, trimer) with DR3(Q93038 25-199) over 6 seeds in 2 disjoint blocks, which predicts a DIFFERENT number: 2826 A^2 total buried, ipTM median 0.8863. THIS ASK IS POST-RESOLUTION AND NOT BLOCKING: our dossier reports the TL1A/DR3 interface from our own measurement and does not depend on the answer. It exists so a wrong row does not propagate to other consumers of g_tl1a1 on the next round. WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT: retrieve p8 and check whether it reports a TL1A/DR3 co-structure at all, or whether the 1840 A^2 figure was computed on a homology model or transferred from the TL1A/DcR3 complex 3K51/3MI8. If it is a model, f10 should carry the model's provenance and L4's basis should not read as a deposited experimental structure.

evidence._what_this_is: The evidence block behind the ask. It is not part of the ask object the upstream team consumes; it is what a human on our side reads to check that the ask was earned.

predicted_interface.method: Boltz-2 multimer via cofold-check.cofold_complex, use_msa=True, 6 seeds in 2 disjoint blocks (42-44, 142-144)
predicted_interface._epitope_note: residues in the predicted interface in ALL SIX seeds
predicted_interface._transfer_note: fraction of the deposited DcR3 epitope on TL1A that the predicted DR3 epitope covers. This is a SITE check and NOT a specificity check - the same number is 0.75 for TL1A/TNFR2, which does not bind, and 0.84 for a composition-scrambled random string.

scramble_floor_same_ligand.note: the scrambled string buried MORE surface than the true complex; that is why contact count and BSA are reported and never gated on

deposited_positive_same_ligand.note: 3K51/3MI8 are deposited and in the training set - this is recall, not prediction

evidence.leakage_note: Boltz-2 trained on the PDB. TL1A/DcR3 (3K51, 3MI8) IS deposited and DR3 is a 26%-identity paralogue of DcR3 (measured, global NW/BLOSUM62 over the ectodomains). The predicted TL1A/DR3 interface is therefore not independent of a memorised complex, and its agreement with the DcR3 epitope is the expected result whether or not DR3 binds there.

entities.desc: Human TNFRSF25 death domain mutant D412E

_fixture_warning: The GRAPH is the synthetic ask-back fixture, so f10/p8 are not citable and the 1840 A^2 claim is invented. THE STRUCTURAL EVIDENCE IS REAL: the PDB census, the 3K51 measurement and the cofold all ran against real data. This is the ask this loop produces when a graph carries a structural claim we can falsify.
